Generate Filipino first names

Source: R/person-identity.R
fkr_first_name.Rd

Draws n given names from a lookup of ~700 male and ~760 female Filipino first names, optionally restricted by sex.

Usage

fkr_first_name(n, sex = c("any", "male", "female"))

Arguments

n

Number of names to generate. A single non-negative whole number.

sex

Restrict the draw to "male" or "female" names, or "any" (the default) to draw from both pools combined.

Value

A character vector of length n.

Examples

fkr_first_name(5)
#> [1] "Mitch"     "Manila"    "Richmond"  "Manila"    "Isabelita"
fkr_first_name(5, sex = "female")
#> [1] "Philomena" "Darcel"    "Ahtisa"    "Guadalupe" "Tiara"
